title: 감사원 정책자문위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 6 (Meetings)
(1) Meetings of the Committee shall be held as regular meetings and ad hoc meetings. Regular meetings shall be held once in each of the first and second halves of every year, and ad hoc meetings shall be held when requested by the Chairperson of the Board of Audit and Inspection. <Amended on Jun. 30, 2016>
(2) Meetings of the Committee shall be convened by the Chairperson, who shall preside over them.
(3) The heads of the offices and bureaus of the Board of Audit and Inspection and other relevant persons may, at the request of the Committee, attend meetings and state their opinions. <Amended on Jun. 30, 2016>
